body:
## Pull request overview

This PR extends ListView’s existing grouping state so it affects all supported view types (Grid, Kanban, Gallery), enabling consistent grouped rendering and behavior across views.

**Changes:**
- Pass `groupingConfig` from `ListView` into the constructed Kanban and Gallery child schemas.
- Add grouped rendering to `ObjectGallery` with collapsible group sections and group sorting.
- Add Kanban schema support for `grouping` and wire `grouping.fields[0].field` as a `swimlaneField` fallback in `ObjectKanban`.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 6 out of 6 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx | Forwards `groupingConfig` into kanban/gallery schema construction. |
| packages/plugin-list/src/ObjectGallery.tsx | Implements grouped + collapsible section rendering when `schema.grouping` is present. |
| packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/GalleryGrouping.test.tsx | Adds unit tests for gallery grouping/collapse/sort/count behavior. |
| packages/plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.tsx | Uses `schema.grouping.fields[0].field` as a `swimlaneField` fallback. |
| packages/plugin-kanban/src/types.ts | Adds `grouping?: GroupingConfig` to `KanbanSchema`. |
| packages/plugin-kanban/src/__tests__/KanbanGrouping.test.tsx | Adds tests around swimlane rendering and resolution logic. |
</details>

`viewComponentSchema` is memoized without `groupingConfig` in the dependency array, so changing grouping via the Group popover can leave the memoized schema stale and not propagate the new `grouping` prop to Kanban/Gallery (and Grid as well). Include `groupingConfig` (and any other referenced state like `rowColorConfig` / `navigation.handleClick`) in the `useMemo` dependencies, or remove the memoization if it’s not needed.

The group toggle button controls visibility of the group content but doesn’t expose its expanded/collapsed state to assistive tech. Add `aria-expanded` (and ideally `aria-controls` pointing at the group panel) so screen readers can understand and announce the toggle state.

The new `grouping → swimlaneField` fallback is not directly covered by a test that renders `ObjectKanban` with `schema.grouping` and asserts it actually produces a swimlane layout. Current tests exercise `KanbanImpl` and a copied resolver function, which won’t fail if `ObjectKanban` stops wiring `schema.grouping` into `swimlaneField`. Add an integration-level unit test for `ObjectKanban` covering explicit `swimlaneField` precedence and grouping fallback.
